notes:
Account summary: mid-market multi-tenant SaaS that embeds chat/agent features into customer portals. Evaluating Hosted API for fast time-to-market, then Dedicated for predictable throughput and tenant isolation. Key asks: tenant-level rate limits/quotas, streaming stability under bursts, tool-calling support (structured events), SSO/SAML + audit trails.

POC highlights: hosted API demo 2026-02-05 showed strong quality and ease of integration (websocket streaming + tool call hooks). Measured TTFB and streaming metrics during POC: p50 time-to-first-byte ~180ms, p95 ~420ms; full short-response latency p50 ~600ms, p95 ~1.8s under medium load. Under heavy concurrent sessions (400+ active chats) observed intermittent chunk skips and reconnects — likely backpressure + client retry behavior.

Customer quotes / asks: "Our SLA to end customers is 300ms first-byte for live chat — anything above that causes escalations." Wants clear fallbacks if dedicated capacity is unavailable. Also needs billing model that supports per-tenant metering and overage rules.

Security & compliance: SOC2 in house, requires SSO/SAML, SSO templates + assertion mapping, audit logging retention 2 years, optional KMS integration for customer-managed keys, and EU data residency for a subset of customers. Requested sample SOC2 artifacts and privacy whitepaper.

Commercials: mid-sized ARR expectation across multiple customers; target is $75k-$250k ARR for initial commitment if Dedicated pricing is competitive. Interested in volume discounts and burst credits.

Next steps captured: schedule pricing deep-dive (AE + Finance + SE), deliver tenant-quota semantics doc and sample rate-limit headers, set up SAML scoping call with security on 2026-03-10, address streaming reconnection patterns in follow-up POC iteration.
